title: tephrosia paniculata var. schizocalyx
intro: Tephrosia paniculata var. schizocalyx, commonly known as "Wild Bitter", is a plant species that belongs to the Fabaceae family. It has been traditionally used in various cultures for its medicinal properties, which include treating fever, rheumatism, and as a purgative. The health benefits of this plant include its anti-inflammatory and antibacterial properties, which contribute to its therapeutic actions, such as reducing pain and inflammation. The bioactive constituents of Tephrosia paniculata var. schizocalyx include alkaloids, saponins, and flavonoids, which are responsible for its medicinal effects.
